metrics.definition: Constant density multiplied by the sum of solver phi on the named boundary; outward-positive. Raw phi and conversion provenance are retained.
Area-weighted mean boundary kinematic pressure from actual p, multiplied by the constant reference density. Values are relative to the solver pressure reference; no absolute-pressure claim is made.
Flux-weighted boundary total pressure from per-face rho*(p + |U|^2/2), only when actual p, U, phi and boundary correspondence are available. Values use the solver pressure reference.
abs(sum boundary mass flow) / max(incoming mass flow, m_floor); not evaluated without a frozen reference floor.

required_metric_naming: Exact metric IDs, e.g. boundary_mass_flow@inlet and static_pressure@outlet. No alias or missing value is inferred.

reference_observations.scope: Analytical diagnostic for fully developed parallel-plate flow. A finite inlet/outlet grid, discrete inlet profile and boundary sampling can differ. Record the observed error; do not convert it to PASS without Owner-approved tolerances.
